shapeSummary: Wheel with a 144 mm outer diameter and 52 mm width. The axis runs along Z, the center sits at Y=72, and the bottom rests on Y=0. A solid cylinder has a 120 mm diameter pocket cut 40 mm deep into the +Z face. This leaves a 12 mm rim ring and a 12 mm thick web at the -Z side. A 32 mm diameter hub boss stands inside the pocket. A 14 mm bore passes through the whole wheel.
warnings: Pocket depth, web thickness and hub boss size are estimated from the images, not dimensioned.
The honeycomb pockets in the outer ring and the lugged tread are omitted, so the tread is a plain cylinder.
The 16 mm and 32 mm square mounting hole patterns are omitted because their diameters and positions are not stated.
The spoked web detail on the hub face is omitted.
The 144 mm diameter, 52 mm width and 14 mm bore come from unverified specs.
